description:
Get a node's DECRYPTED content by name_hash PLUS its connected nodes' content (neighbour
    depth, default 1; 0–5). Same plan schema as the structure tools. Content scope required (403).

include_neighbours_depth.description: How many hops of connected nodes to include, 0-5 (clamped). Default 1.
include_neighbours_depth.title: Include Neighbours Depth

name_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the entity's normalised name. Send it: without it the plan has no entity filter.
name_hash.title: Name Hash

name: get_node_content
